source: Nate Bloom's own plugins (natebloom/, Faust) and the community collection: wam-community 0.4.9 (https://github.com/boourns/wam-community)

plugins.name: Marimba
plugins.desc: Wooden bars and tube resonators struck with a mallet. Hard mallets bring out the attack; soft ones the tone.

plugins.name: Nylon Guitar
plugins.desc: A classical guitar string and body. Pluck near the bridge for bite, toward the middle for warmth.

plugins.name: Violin
plugins.desc: A bowed string: bow pressure and position, slow or sharp attacks, and vibrato that grows as the note sustains.

plugins.name: Flute
plugins.desc: Breath, embouchure and vibrato: breathy and soft or bright and pure.

plugins.name: Clarinet
plugins.desc: Reed stiffness and bell opening shape a woody, hollow tone.

plugins.name: Voice
plugins.desc: A singing voice, bass to soprano, with vowels you can glide between: choirs and vocal pads.

plugins.name: DRM-16 DrumComputer
plugins.desc: 16-pad MIDI drum sampler

plugins.name: Spectrum: Modal
plugins.desc: Port of a popular eurorack modal synthesizer.  It is a full-blown synthesis voice based on modal synthesis - an under-appreciated flavour of physical modelling synthesis with a strange and abstract feel.

plugins.name: Synth-101
plugins.desc: Software clone of a simple monophonic synthesizer classic, the Roland SH-101

plugins.name: Hall
plugins.desc: A big, smooth stereo hall that keeps its low end apart from its shimmer. Long decays for ambient washes.

plugins.name: Plate
plugins.desc: The classic studio plate: dense, bright and quick to bloom. Lovely on vocals, snares and keys.

plugins.name: Grey Hole
plugins.desc: A reverb insoired by the famous Eventinde/Blackhole effect. Authors: Michel Buffa for making it a WAM, Quentin Beauchet for improving the GUI, original faust code Julian Parker, bug fixes by Till Bovermann.

plugins.name: KBVerb
plugins.desc: A reverb inspired by https://valhalladsp.com/2010/08/25/rip-keith-barr/ Authors: Michel Buffa for making it a WAM, Quentin Beauchet for improving the GUI, original faust code originated from Stephane Letz.

plugins.name: OwlDirty
plugins.desc: A stereo ambient reverberation with a distortion stage on the reverb tail. Authors: Michel Buffa for making it a WAM, Quentin Beauchet for improving the GUI, original faust code by Xavier (https://www.rebeltech.org/patch-library/patch/Owlgazer_Dirty_Reverb/)

plugins.name: OWLShimmer
plugins.desc: A stereo ambient reverberation with a shimmer effect. Authors: Michel Buffa for making it a WAM, Quentin Beauchet for improving the GUI, original faust code by Xavier (https://www.rebeltech.org/patch-library/patch/Owlgazer_Dirty_Reverb/)

plugins.name: Tape Echo
plugins.desc: Repeats that darken, saturate and wobble like worn tape, bouncing left and right. Push Feedback past 100% for runaway echoes.

plugins.name: PingPongDelay
plugins.desc: A classic Ping Pong Delay written using WebAudio standard nodes. Authors: Michel Buffa, Q. Beauchet for GUI improvements.

plugins.name: Simple Delay
plugins.desc: Simple stereo filtered delay

plugins.name: SmoothDelay
plugins.desc: Delay that does't click or transpose when the delay time is changed, in Faust. Author: Yann Orlarey.

plugins.name: Cloud
plugins.desc: Grains of what you play, scattered in time and pitch and fed back into themselves. Set Pitch to 0 / +12 for shimmering clouds.

plugins.name: Ensemble
plugins.desc: The three-voice string-machine ensemble: slow swirl plus fast shimmer, the sound of a Solina and Vangelis-era pads.

plugins.name: Juno Chorus
plugins.desc: The Juno-60's bucket-brigade chorus: I, II, or both at once for the fast, shimmering vibrato.

plugins.name: Auto-Pan
plugins.desc: Tremolo (Pan at 0) or auto-pan (Pan at 100): smooth or choppy.

plugins.name: Ring Mod
plugins.desc: A ring modulator for bells, metallic shimmer and alien drones, with a slow drift on the carrier.

plugins.name: Stereo Enhancer
plugins.desc: Stereo Width/Enhancer effect using the Blumlein Shuffler technique. Author: Michel Buffa.

plugins.name: StonePhaser
plugins.desc: This is an analog phaser with similarity to the Small Stone. It has a color switch, which makes the phasing stronger when on, and adds some feedback controls. Authors: Michel Buffa for making it a WAM, Q. Beauchet for GUI improvements, original faust Code by jpcima https://github.com/jpcima/stone-phaser

plugins.name: ThruZeroFlanger
plugins.desc: Thru-zero flanger that models a pair of tape delays with rate/depth/feedback/synchronization modes controls. Authors: Michel Buffa for making it a WAM, Q. Beauchet for GUI improvements, original Faust Code : Oli Larkin
plugins.site: Original web site with faust code by O.Larkin : https://www.rebeltech.org/patch-library/patch/Thru_zero_flanger

plugins.name: WeirdPhaser
plugins.desc: Weird Phaser is a stereo phase shifter based on SSB (single side band) modulation. Unlike Stereo Frequency Shifter, Weird Phaser uses a single LFO which has a fixed phase offset for the right hand channel, causing some interesting between the ears spatial effects at its maximum settting. Weird Phaser also has feedback for a more pronounced effect. Authors: Michel Buffa for making it a WAM, Q. Beauchet for GUI improvements, original Faust Code : Oli Larkin
plugins.site: Original web site with faust code by O.Larkin : https://www.rebeltech.org/patch-library/patch/WeirdPhaser

plugins.name: Ladder Filter
plugins.desc: A Moog-style ladder filter with an LFO and an envelope follower: slow sweeps, swells, or wah when you play harder.

plugins.name: Blipper
plugins.desc: Blipper is an Envelope Follower which controls the pitch of a triangle oscillator. It is a rough emulation of some of the features of the BOSS PC-2 Percussion Synthesiser. Arthur Russell used something like this to create interesting percussion parts on his records e.g. <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LEZevPziZhY>. It works nicely with drums. Authors: Michel Buffa for making it a WAM, Q. Beauchet for GUI improvements, original Faust Code : Oli Larkin
plugins.site: Original web site with faust code by O.Larkin : https://www.rebeltech.org/patch-library/patch/Blipper

plugins.name: GraphicEqualizer
plugins.desc: A graphic equalizer proposing a bank of filters. Drag control points. Use shift+drag for peaking filters to adjust the curve. Author: Michel Buffa.

plugins.name: Simple EQ
plugins.desc: Simple three-band equalizer

plugins.name: SweetWah
plugins.desc: An autowah effect with modulation. Authors: Michel Buffa for making it a WAM, Q. Beauchet for GUI improvements, original faust code https://github.com/pingdynasty/OwlPatches/blob/master/Faust/SweepWah.dsp

plugins.name: Tape
plugins.desc: A tape machine: soft saturation, a low-end bump, rolled-off highs, wow and flutter and a little hiss. Age takes it from fresh to worn.

plugins.name: Lo-Fi
plugins.desc: Fewer bits, a lower sample rate, a worn-record wobble, crackle and a dark filter.

plugins.name: Big Muff
plugins.desc: A reproduction of the BigMuff original Fuzz pedal. Original code from Guitarix project. WAM by Michel Buffa.

plugins.name: KppDistorder
plugins.desc: This plugin is a distortion pedal emulator with equalizer. Authors: Michel Buffa for making it a WAM, Quentin Beauchet for improving the GUI, Oleg Kapitonov for the original FAUST code

plugins.name: KppFuzz
plugins.desc: This plugin is a vintage fuzz pedal emulator. Authors: Michel Buffa for making it a WAM, Quentin Beauchet for improving the GUI, Oleg Kapitonov for the original FAUST code.

plugins.name: OSCTube
plugins.desc: Tube fuzz effect with vibrato, resonance and fuzz controls. Authors: Michel Buffa for making it a WAM, Quentin Beauchet for improving the GUI, Guitarix Team for the original FAUST code

plugins.name: Overdriverix
plugins.desc: Overdrive effect implemented in Faust. Authors: Michel Buffa for making it a WAM, Quentin Beauchet for improving the GUI, Guitarix Team for the original FAUST code

plugins.name: QuadraFuzz
plugins.desc: A multiband fuzz effect inspired by the Quadrafuzz VST. Authors: Michel Buffa, Q. Beauchet for GUI improvements

plugins.name: Simple Distortion
plugins.desc: Simple waveshaper-based distortion with variable curve and gain

plugins.name: Temper
plugins.desc: Modern digital distortion. It builds upon traditional waveshaping techniques using modulated filter coefficients to produce a unique phase distortion. Authors: Michel Buffa for making it a WAM, Q. Beauchet for GUI improvements, original code Nick Thomson (https://github.com/creativeintent/temper)

plugins.name: TS9 Overdrive
plugins.desc: A recreation of the classic TS9 overdrive pedal effect. Authors: Michel Buffa for making it a WAM, Q. Beauchet for GUI improvements, original Faust code by the guitarix team

plugins.name: Bus Compressor
plugins.desc: Glue for the whole mix. Lower Mix for parallel (New York) compression: punch without losing the transients.

plugins.name: Vox Amp 30
plugins.desc: GuitarAmpSIm60s is a tube guitar amp sim, inspired by old Vox AC30 amps. Authors: Michel Buffa for making it a wam. Original code by the Guitarix team.

plugins.name: DualPitchShifter
plugins.desc: Dual Pitch Shifter is a dual channel pitch shifter, based on Faust’s pitch_shifter.dsp by Grame. Pitch shifting is (intentionally) extremely basic and introduces significant delay based on window size.
plugins.site: Original web site with faust code by O.Larkin : https://www.rebeltech.org/patch-library/patch/DualPitchShifter. Authors: Michel Buffa for making it a WAM, Q. Beauchet for GUI improvements, original Faust Code : Oli Larkin

plugins.name: StereoFreqShifter
plugins.desc: Stereo Frequency Shifter is a twin frequency shifter with linked control of frequency shift for each channel, that can be slightly offset for lush stereo phasing. Authors: Michel Buffa for making it a WAM, Q. Beauchet for GUI improvements, original Faust Code : Oli Larkin
plugins.site: Original web site with faust code by O.Larkin : https://www.rebeltech.org/patch-library/patch/StereoFreqShifter

plugins.name: DeathGate
plugins.desc: This plugin is a multiband noise gate, works pretty well with distorded guitars, drums, bass, etc. Authors: Michel Buffa for making it a WAM, Quentin Beauchet for improving the GUI, Oleg Kapitonov for the original FAUST code
